incidents.vector: After Microsoft revoked its fraudulently obtained code-signing certificates, the Lorem Ipsum loader operators pivoted to 'ClickFix' lures on at least five compromised WordPress sites, tricking visitors into pasting a malicious PowerShell command disguised as a browser update.
incidents.impact: The campaign, now linked to the financially motivated ransomware group also tracked as Vice Society/Vanilla Tempest, drops a multistage backdoor that establishes a foothold for follow-on ransomware deployment; the new model broadens the victim pool from fake-installer downloaders to anyone visiting an infected site.

incidents.victim: US & Canadian medical, academic & military research institutions
incidents.vector: The actor exploited externally facing REDCap research-survey servers, deployed custom 'INFINITERED' malware to harvest credentials and persist through software upgrades, pivoted to domain-admin accounts, then abused mail content-compliance rules to silently BCC-forward emails to attacker mailboxes.
incidents.impact: Google/Mandiant found the group undetected for over two years (since Sept 2023), targeting defense intelligence, AI, uncrewed systems, cyber programs and medical research across institutions with billions in combined research budgets; Google disrupted infrastructure but assesses known victims are a fraction of the campaign.

incidents.vector: An unattributed cyberattack earlier in June disrupted the company's services; Astral disclosed no technical details, citing an active investigation involving Russian government agencies.
incidents.impact: Services used for tax reporting, electronic document management, cash registers, corporate email and digital-certificate authentication were down for about a week, affecting customers including Russian Post and Moscow's Mosgortrans; Astral reports no evidence of customer data being leaked.

incidents.victim: Polish government officials, journalists, researchers & their families
incidents.vector: CERT Polska warned that a Belarus-linked group expanded credential-phishing operations to personal Gmail accounts, registering new phishing domains almost daily to steal logins and two-factor codes.
incidents.impact: Successful compromises expose contact lists, sensitive documents and linked accounts used to identify further targets and hijack social media; the group is also tied to influence and disinformation operations aimed at undermining Poland's ties with Ukraine, the US and NATO.

incidents.vector: Finnish prosecutors charged the captain and bosun of the cargo ship Fitburg — carrying sanctioned Russian steel — with dragging its anchor along the seabed for at least 130km, damaging two subsea cables and attempting to damage eight more on New Year's Eve.
incidents.impact: The charges follow a string of Baltic cable faults feared to be Russian sabotage; the defendants deny wrongdoing and dispute Finnish jurisdiction, and several European officials now assess many such incidents were likely accidental rather than Kremlin-directed.

incidents.vector: The ransomware-as-a-service crew known as 'The Gentlemen' targets Internet-facing devices (VPNs, firewalls) for initial access and encrypts entire networks within hours, recruiting skilled affiliates with an unusually generous 90/10 revenue split.
incidents.impact: Now the second most active ransomware operation by victim count, the group claims 332+ victims since mid-2025 (240+ in 2026); Krebs/Check Point/Intel 471 research tied its Russia-based administrator to a named individual in Izhevsk, Russia.

incidents.victim: Microsoft (Azure Durable Task SDK code repositories)
incidents.vector: A variant of the self-propagating Shai-Hulud worm infected at least 72 of Microsoft's public code repositories, all connected to the official Azure Durable Task SDK, reusing stolen tokens to spread and steal developer credentials.
incidents.impact: The incident is part of a wave of npm/PyPI supply-chain compromises (also seen in the Red Hat npm 'Miasma' campaign) that can silently infect CI/CD pipelines and developer systems; NCSC urged organizations to audit dependencies, rotate tokens and enforce MFA on registry accounts.

incidents.victim: Organizations running Check Point security gateways / VPNs
incidents.vector: An improper-authentication flaw (CVE-2026-50751) in Check Point Security Gateway remote-access tools, firewalls and VPNs is being actively exploited by the Qilin ransomware operation to gain entry to corporate networks.
incidents.impact: CISA added the bug to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog and gave federal agencies just three days to patch; a separate Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager zero-day (CVE-2026-20245) was also added amid active exploitation.

incidents.victim: Obama White House & U.S. Space Force Instagram accounts (Meta)
incidents.vector: Pro-Iran hackers circulated a Telegram technique to trick Meta's AI customer-support bot into adding an attacker email to a target account during the password-reset flow, enabling account takeover via a VPN IP near the victim's hometown.
incidents.impact: The Instagram accounts of the Obama White House and the Chief Master Sergeant of the U.S. Space Force were briefly defaced with pro-Iranian messages; Meta pushed an emergency patch over the weekend and said no back-end database was breached.

incidents.victim: European government targets (incl. Danish government bodies)
incidents.vector: Dutch financial-crime investigators arrested two co-owners of hosting firms (the[.]hosting / MIRhosting) that took over the technical infrastructure of EU-sanctioned 'Stark Industries Solutions', a frequent staging ground for Russian DDoS, influence and disinformation operations.
incidents.impact: Authorities seized 800+ servers, laptops and phones; data reviewed by de Volkskrant showed the networks were the most-used in pro-Russian attacks on Danish government bodies during the week of Denmark's November 2025 municipal elections.
